title: Code node body-enrich did NOT reproduce 0.385 to 0.647 lift on current code: recall-neutral-to-negative due to codebase drift evidence chunk 3
summary: ROOT CAUSE = codebase drift, not a bug. The proof onboarded at main commit 0915d0c; I onboarded the attempt-branch tip. 206/1170 lib+routes symbols (18%) now live in lib/subconscious/ + lib/search/ — subtrees that barely existed at 0915d0c, full of generic-named helpers (keepEdge, seedObject, reinforceEdge, composeSearchContextEnvelope) whose BODIES are dense with embedding/search/edge vocabulary. Folding those bodies in makes them cosine-match the NL queries (which are ABOUT search/gates/edges) BETTER than the thin name+signature of the true target, so they crowd the top-6 and displace the real answer. Confirmed live: q03 askGate ranks #1 cos=0.445 THIN, but drops out of top-40 ENRICHED (replaced by ~0.22 generic helpers). The body dilutes the concentrated name/signature signal. At 0915d0c that subtree didn't exist so bodies were pure signal.
